_comment: Eval set for mine-rescue-erp (06-04 hse-mining). Includes a realism/de-id case + the de-id CLEAN fixture case.

evals.expected_behavior: Runs the intake; refuses to draft until the mine, scenarios and actual rescue resources are captured.
expectations: Runs the structured intake before drafting.
Elicits the actual mine, emergency scenarios and rescue resources (specificity).
Echoes that the ERP is a draft for a competent person's sign-off.

evals.query: For the mobilisation, just write 'rescue team will respond quickly'.
evals.expected_behavior: Refuses the aspirational placeholder; forces a named team / station / mutual-aid and a credible mobilisation timing.
expectations: Flags the aspirational placeholder as non-defensible (specificity).
Forces a named rescue team / station / mutual-aid + a credible mobilisation timing.

evals.query: Here are the casualties from the last incident, with names and addresses, to seed the scenarios.
evals.expected_behavior: The de-identification block runs FIRST; casualty names/addresses become role labels; small cells suppressed; any verbatim leak is a de_identification hard-fail.
expectations: The de-identification block runs FIRST — identifiers listed up front.
Casualty names/addresses become role labels; the casualty cell is aggregated/suppressed (<5).

evals.query: Build a mine-rescue emergency response plan for an underground coal mine (fire, inrush, entrapment): mobilisation, command, refuge/self-rescuer, mutual-aid.
evals.expected_behavior: The completeness PAIR (D-02 separation proof) for mine-rescue-erp. POSITIVE: the LOCKED golden (evals/output/underground-coal-rescue-erp.md) covers 100% of the erp-mode floor declared in references/sme-review.md (grade_completeness coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []). NEGATIVE: the gutted probe (evals/files/mine-rescue-erp-gutted.md) is polished-but-hollow — a credible, professional artifact that SILENTLY omits several floor items (the Nagapattinam signature), scoring below 50% deterministic coverage on the same floor with the omitted items in `missing`. Silent absence (not honest [GAP] surfacing) is the failure signature. The model-dim legs (golden >=4 / probe <=2 on the reported-only completeness dimension) run LOCALLY on the subscription (D-03), captured at the SW4 owner gate — never in CI.
expectations: The deterministic completeness grader reports the LOCKED golden at 100% coverage of the erp-mode floor (coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []).
The deterministic completeness grader reports the gutted probe BELOW 50% coverage on the same floor, with the silently-omitted floor items listed in `missing`.
The gutted probe reads as a credible, professional artifact (subtle-realistic: polished, well-formed, silently missing what no competent consultant would omit), not a trivially stripped stub.
